name: HTTP Status Code Lookup
description: Search every HTTP status code (1xx-5xx) — official name, meaning, and category — including the less-common WebDAV and rate-limiting codes.

faq.question: What does the first digit of a status code mean?
faq.answer: It tells you the response's class before you read anything else: 1xx is informational, 2xx is success, 3xx is redirection, 4xx is a client error (something about the request was wrong), and 5xx is a server error (the request was valid but the server failed to fulfill it).

faq.question: Is 418 "I'm a Teapot" a real status code?
faq.answer: Yes, technically — it originated as an April Fools' joke in RFC 2324 (and was later kept alive in RFC 7168) but is a real, registered code some servers and frameworks implement for fun or as an easter egg. It's not something you'd design an API around.
